purpose: Spec-driven planning advisor for task framing gaps and next-work candidates. User-language phrases should normalize to these English canonical triggers through semantic adaptation or learned aliases.

collaborative_control.why: Normal agent sessions should keep the operator in the loop: frame the selected work, wait for an approved start intent, then claim the task for implementation.

suggestions: State the observable objective of this task.
Tie the objective to a task, improvement, or decision ref.
Record assumptions that shape the implementation path.
Mark assumptions that must be verified before mutation.
Record architectural, runtime, safety, or user constraints.
Prefer governed laws/cues over free-text reminders.
Define verification evidence or live-smoke criteria.
Define what is explicitly out of scope.
Record whether verification is test-only, live-only, or both.

next_work_rules.why: Open tasks are already promoted work and should be considered before raw backlog ideas.
Improvements are embryonic tasks; surface them when no promoted open task is available.
No open task or improvement is available; ask the operator to create or import backlog work.
